summary: A Depth 20 subscribe: the desktop answers success at depth 5 and streams the five-level book; the web adapter refuses any Depth level but 5, so the web streams nothing.

notes: Web acknowledgement worked from pocketful_adapter.py:256-259 (INVALID_DEPTH before the capability fallback, which is never reached) and server.py:1319-1336: {"type": "subscribe", "status": "partial", "subscriptions": [{"symbol": "RELIANCE", "exchange": "NSE", "status": "error", "message": "Invalid depth level 20. Must be 5", "broker": "pocketful"}], "message": "Subscription processing complete", "broker": "pocketful"}.

deviations.reason: The web refuses a Depth subscribe at any level but 5 (INVALID_DEPTH), so it streams nothing; the desktop acknowledges it at depth 5 and streams the book (feed::dialect lists Pocketful as Fallback). The acknowledgement and this frame follow from the same rule: refuse like the web, or keep the fallback as a decision the lead approves.
